authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL gāva subsection 3 gāvī explicitly gives Phalura ghāu cow and Awankari gā̃, plural gāī̃. The selected Phal gʰāo and Awankari gʰā survey responses are assigned to that specific branch; source aspiration, diphthong and nasal notation are preserved, rather than silently replacing them with the dictionary spelling. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: gʰā.
